name: rheon-tail
description: The last N Flux records -- tail for records, terminator not counted.
notes:
The last N Flux records -- tail for records. Unlike plain tail it does not count the terminator as a record; it reads to the end, and ends with tail-stats:complete (count, records) when upstream said it finished.

Prototype for #62 (2026-10-13); promoted to Rust in #78 (2026-10-14), with the Python version kept as the diff-test reference. Short names fhead / ftail (decided 2026-10-14, matching fsort / fcount): the npm packages of the same names only collide for someone who installs them globally -- the #57 shape.
